phase: development; two reused world seeds, no confirmatory claim
qa_split: 50% within each chain's group and old-exception stratum; identical across organizations
primary_learning: heldout full-answer accuracy for each of the 3 organizations x 2 chains at 15360 steps
general_benefit: each organized condition's two-task average minus neither condition's two-task average
secondary_learning: all prespecified checkpoints, base accuracy, trained QA, NLL, prerequisite-known subset with denominator
primary_edit: fixed 512-step E, D trained/heldout, exception-conflict D, and full/heldout retention counts by stratum
aggregation: first pair within world/initialization; then equal-weight four paired blocks; no probe-level significance
limitations: Two reused development worlds; two initializations do not create four independent worlds
New symmetric company/project task adds facts; not a numerical rerun of the archived A/B/C batch
All conditions preserve personal grouping; neither is a B-like control, not the old C condition
Tests relation alignment, not unseen natural-language paraphrases
Identical surface QA streams do not rule out task-specific learned representations
No early stopping, best-checkpoint selection, or outcome-dependent extension
